_comment: The local stand-in for each domain's Glue catalog: the one part of a dataset
the descriptor does not carry. Columns are what each example pipeline's SQL
produces; CI runs those pipelines and fails if a column list here differs
from the Parquet they write. lf_tags on a column override the table's tags
for that key, as LakeFormation column tags do, and every value is checked
against the runtime's ontology when the catalog loads. The IBAN columns carry
an explicit tag, as the fabric-mesh-on-aws Terraform tags policy.customer.iban.
Both tables are already sensitivity=high, so today the column tag repeats the
table's; it keeps the IBAN high if the table's classification is ever lowered.
